tieu_de: Middle Business Analyst HRM, ERP, Oracle
ten_cong_ty: Công ty cổ phần công nghệ Unitrust Việt Nam
dia_chi_raw: 342 My Dinh, Tu Liem, Hanoi, Vietnam
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Conduct workshops with clients to gather, analyze, and clarify business requirements for HR modules such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance Management, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Succession & Development, and Training.
Prepare and maintain project documentation, including URD, SRS, FSD, Use Cases, User Stories, Wireframes, Test Cases, Training Materials, and User Guides.
Analyze current business processes and propose optimized future-state processes.
Perform FIT-GAP analysis between customer requirements and Oracle PeopleSoft standard functionalities; propose standard solutions and workaround approaches.
Design functional solutions and collaborate with the Development team to deliver technical solutions.
Configure Oracle PeopleSoft for standard functional requirements.
Act as the primary liaison between clients, Project Managers, Developers, and QA teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Prepare test scenarios, execute SIT, support UAT, and coordinate issue resolution with stakeholders.
Support Project Managers in requirement management, scope control, and business risk assessment.
Deliver end-user training and provide post-go-live support.
Ensure all project deliverables and business documents are reviewed, approved, and signed off by clients.
yeu_cau:
1. The Fundamentals
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
At least 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
Experience working directly with customers in software implementation projects.
2. Technical & System Skills
Strong understanding of Human Resource Management (HRM) processes and HR/ERP systems.
Experience preparing business and functional documents, including: URD (User Requirement Document), SRS, Functional Specification Document (FSD), FIT-GAP Analysis, Use Case, User Story, Wireframe, Test Cases, Training Materials, User Manuals
Strong business analysis, process modeling, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Experience conducting workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and stakeholder management.
Ability to work closely with Project Managers, Developers, QA/Testers, and business users throughout the SDLC.
Experience supporting SIT, UAT, user training, and production rollout.
Nice to have:
Hands-on experience implementing Oracle PeopleSoft is highly preferred.
Experience with HRM/ERP solutions such as SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday, or similar platforms
Experience working with clients in the Banking or Financial Services sector is a strong advantage.
Knowledge of Vietnam Labor Law, Personal Income Tax (PIT), Social Insurance (BHXH), Health Insurance (BHYT), and Unemployment Insurance (BHTN) regulations is preferred.
Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proactive, analytical, detail-oriented, and able to work independently. 3. Other 
Own a personal laptop (500,000 VND/month)
